fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (TSLA) received approval from Finnish Transportation Authority to offer its Full Self-Driving (FSD) system, driving stock up 4% to $393.59, with EU-level approval expected in winter.
fields.summary_ko.1: Lucid Group (LCID) fell 2% to $3.70 as Citi lowered its target price from $11 to $9, with Q3 deliveries declining 7% YoY to 3,806 units.
fields.summary_ko.2: Rivian Automotive (RIVN) recorded Q3 revenue of $2.15B (up 38.3% YoY) but fell 0.8% to $13.59 amid broader EV industry weakness.
